migration.notes: Initial ATM engineering change method profile catalog.

profiles.title: Expand / contract migration
applicability: Broad public contract changes where old and new forms must coexist temporarily.
guardrails: Do not remove old callers before proving zero remaining usage.

profiles.title: TDD oracle fidelity
applicability: Behavior work where expected values can be derived independently of the implementation.
requiredObservations: green case reuses same case id
rollback: revert candidate while retaining red fixture
guardrails: Expected values must not be copied from the implementation under test.

profiles.title: Replaceable review smell heuristics
applicability: Advisory review patterns that should inform, not outrank, repository standards.
rollback: disable heuristic without removing standards/spec checks
guardrails: Smells remain evidence selectors below Standards and Spec findings.

profiles.title: Merge conflict intent provenance
applicability: Conflict repair where both sides may encode valid but incompatible goals.
rollback: abort merge or revert conflict-resolution commit
guardrails: Never mandate ours/theirs as a general policy.

profiles.title: Deep module refactor
applicability: Refactors that reduce caller complexity behind a stable interface.
rollback: revert module extraction without changing caller contract
guardrails: File length is advisory; depth comes from removed caller complexity.
